findings.observed: The recursive vendor pattern includes five generated CPython bytecode cache files.
findings.impact: Campaign identity depends on locally generated interpreter/path-dependent caches; a source-only restore can change identity or fail frozen-input verification.
findings.minimal_repair: Exclude __pycache__, .pyc and .pyo when expanding scientific input files. Record explicit scientific source paths or finalize broad-pattern auxiliary files before freeze.
findings.verification: Adding/removing an untracked cache file must leave the frozen file list and base identity unchanged; refresh plan identity only.
